en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to theoretically and practically clarify the principles and technological procedures - the cultivation of containerized planting stock used in the establishment of forest stands and plantings in the landscape, its handling, transport and quality assessment.

en.label: [section] Course content:
